title: Federal Source Code Inventory (gov-code.json)
description: An index of software projects developed by the U.S. federal government, compiled from agency-index.json inventories. Records are grouped by agency and each release describes one project, including its name, repository URL, license, development status, contract number, maintenance type, contact, and reuse frequencies.

rights: This data asset is an open government data asset. It is not exempt from disclosure under FOIA. It is a public data asset eligible for disclosure in the Federal Data Catalog. It is available at no cost to the public in open, machine-readable formats and under an open license. Individual projects listed in the index are governed by their own licenses, recorded per project in the permissions.license field.
